lead.headline: No claim tonight; Footballers closed the gap
lead.deck: Claims clear at 02:00. Nothing on the wire beats this roster, and the matchup is now 50-50.
lead.body: Bad news first: Coen says Tuten 'probably won't be able to do a ton' in practice this week and will decide 'towards the end of the week'. Footballers started Smith-Njigba, Judkins and Watson this afternoon, and ESPN's 64% this morning is now 50%. On the wire, Antonio Williams has a real role (McLaurin is out for the season) but no seat behind Jefferson, Wilson and Diggs. Tucker's and Bernard's volume belongs to players who are coming back. Coker cleared concussion protocol on Monday and still has not passed 50 yards since Week 6. Make no claim before 02:00. If Tuten sits on Sunday, Gordon moves to RB and Diggs takes FLEX.

players.caption: Limited practice expected; decision late in the week.
